paraphrase: Gaṇeśa, coming as guru, removes the five senses' hold, shows the six supports and the channels, rouses the coiled power through the central channel, lets the nectar of the moon be tasted, and reveals the Lord within the heart.
speaker: Auvaiyār
notes: Recalled from memory (no local e-text); cited by incipit because verse numbers differ between editions. No original given. Summary of the whole short poem, recalled in outline.
